resolved_finding.original_problem: V2 claimed an all-path upper bound of five forwards, but a missed inotify/SIGSTOP window can allow the two original Restored forwards before failure.
resolved_finding.derivation: For seed137 KEEP, Parent has three jobs, Candidate has two, Restored has two. Whole original roundtrip is at most seven. A successfully frozen post-publication/pre-inverse window admits at most the first five.
resolved_finding.authorized_resolution: Before any control execution, V3 declares all-path upper bound seven and separately reports successful-captured-window upper bound five. Failure retains possible original Restored work and permits no retry.

checked.finding: Plan/run bind control, main, transport, exact native source tree and package, both CI lanes, a previously PASS primary result and the independently fixed input-index SHA. Every case is rederived from that index.

Derived bytes equal original bytes plus one fixed trailing marker. Entry point, ELF header, program-header table and every PT_LOAD payload hash are unchanged. Both actually running /proc/PID/exe files are fully hashed. The derived executable is explicitly not newly qualified.

At pinned native source, evaluator/source/whole-executable identity checks precede jobs, phase charging and worker spawn. Preserving the original executable prefix and loaded segments preserves the embedded evaluator/transaction sources, while the whole executable SHA changes. First recovery must report exactly the identity refusal, no alternate error.

Before changed process start, before first recovery and after its return, checks compare the saved Linux boot ID, CLOCK_BOOTTIME and original wall deadline. The original attempt is not renewed. First recovery PASS therefore cannot be attributed merely to an expired window.
Only the isolated copied workspace parent is unlinked after the stopped crash. Recovery must report that it did not open the original source path, and the path must remain absent.

The inverse is read back against all original checkpoint bytes and the complete parent graph, route, initial-state/evaluator function capsule. A distinct restoration artifact is required even though the KEEP parent and candidate weight SHA are equal.

All phase charge/result file presence and content hashes remain equal across changed-executable recovery; the saved intent is unchanged. A second recovery must preserve the full effect inventory and phase records. No new phase refund, compiler call, selection or forward is credited.

Original preparation plus roundtrip may invoke two pure compilers. New changed-executable recovery forwards and compilers are zero; this is distinct from the original crash attempt's all-path seven-call upper bound. Actual interrupted work is explicitly not claimed exact.

Processes use new sessions, loopback authenticated MCP, private credentials and resource ceilings. Stop/KILL is restricted to owned process groups; a missed publication window is terminal failure without automatic retry.

execution_preconditions: Both full CI lanes must actually be successful and the exact primary qualification must PASS before this separate negative control is planned/run.
Use the reviewed V3 control/source hashes and a newly reviewed plan; never execute the old V2 five-call declaration.
Keep actual terminal status, elapsed time, partial-work uncertainty and cleanup receipts; static PASS is not evidence of runtime PASS.
limitations: Zero Runtime processes, model forwards, compilers or fits were executed by this reviewer.
The proof is source-control-flow plus fixed-byte identity review for this one graph-only seed137 control, not evidence that arbitrary upgraded executables are compatible.
Post-hook/ledger records do not reveal the exact amount of an interrupted forward; the conservative all-path bound remains necessary.

The 180-second recorder budget is checked at operations and completion; failure cleanup has bounded additional waits and must retain its observed elapsed time rather than being described as an independent hard process deadline.
The ELF check establishes preserved declared load image bytes, not absence of all self-inspection behavior; whole-file self-identity is intentionally different.
